title: Electronic structure regulation of RuIrTaOx induces highly efficient acidic OER
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4181-4185
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00290G, Paper
Wenou Bai, Ailing Yan, Yucan Dong, Jingai Wang, Bo Jia, Qing Feng
A high-performance RuIrTaOx nanosheet low-iridium catalyst for PEM water electrolysis can be stable for 500 h at 1A cm−2 , with a degradation rate of only 27 μV h−1.
